_what: How tool:practice (read-data/practice-cards.mjs) keeps cards. `types` are the record types of the cards, of each grade given and of the person's spacing policy (the policy itself is the person's: starting ease, the first two gaps, the lapse quality, the grade words and their quality, and optionally the field named by `mastery_field`, the interval in days that counts as fully learned). `default_policy_id` is the policy record used when a request names none. A card's id is `card_id_start`, its deck and the first `card_id_hex` hex digits of the BLAKE3 of its deck and prompt; a grade's id starts with `grade_id_start`. `mastery_scale` is what a fully learned card reads as. `due_limit_default` is how many due cards `due` lists when no limit is asked. `words` are what the answers say.

words.no_policy: No spacing policy is kept: give policy in the request, or keep one as a record of the policy type. This tool has no default.
words.remind_one: 1 card is due to practise now.
words.remind_many: {count} cards are due to practise now.
words.remind_none: Nothing is due to practise now.
